description: `GET /system/v1/whoami` returns a top-level `total_row_count` the spec's `WhoAmIResponse` does not declare, and it is `null`. Live call on 2026-11-17 against a development environment: HTTP 200, body `{"total_row_count":null,"data":{"permissions":[…],"organization_name":…,"environment_type":"development",…}}`. Without the member, `ResponseValidation.strict` fails the call with `MuxParseError` (unmodeled key). Adds `total_row_count` as an optional, nullable integer.
